column3: NASB’s wording “which, not written in the book” is awkward; the Hebrew reads “which is not written.”
“few in number” renders “with men of fewness”; “obey the LORD” renders “listen to the voice of the LORD.”
“delighted over you” renders “rejoiced over you”; “prosper you” renders “do you good.”
“hang in doubt” renders “be hung up”; “have no assurance of your life” renders “not trust in your life.”
“Would that it were” renders the Hebrew wish “Who will give.”
